name: @poyetik/wasm-build
description: Builds a WebAssembly module of the project reproducibly (no path of the building machine inside), checks that two builds are the same bytes, and instruments a module to count the instructions it executes, and checks a module's cost benchmarks against their baseline: shared by every WebAssembly package (the audio engine's, the visual library's and the page module's).

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
